title: Ancient chess pieces in Mongolian burial mounds as an alien gift

tellings.quote: Mongolia, there are archaeological excavations, burial mounds, and in one of these burial mounds, they actually found these kinds of figures, some of which are more than 5,000 years old.

plain: Chess-like figures dug out of burial mounds in Mongolia, some "more than 5,000 years old," are offered as a sign that chess was a gift from aliens. The claim comes from Kiran Ilum Xenov, a guest introduced as a former president of a Russian republic who says he was taken by aliens in 1997; he tells Michels about the excavations without naming a source, and also points to Peru. If true, the game would be far older than history says and would not be of human origin.
